question: How is the teaching just imparted characterized in terms of supreme value?
premises: This has been told to you
It is the essence of essence
It is the supreme of the supreme
inference: The imparted teaching is the most essential and supreme knowledge.
uncertainties: The internal sandhi/compound analysis of sārātsāraṃ and parātparam follows traditional readings.
plain_english: Indeed, this has been told to you as the essence of essences, the supreme of the supreme.
